comment: Designer workflows of upstream/docs/manual.md. scripts/workflows.py replays each one with upstream's core on the host and writes <name>.json; tests/e2e/designer.spec.ts replays it in the web IDE and compares the saved project. Ids that a step generates are normalised.

workflows.name: resolution-stretch-unlinks-board
workflows.manual: 7. Resolution: Common 480×480, Stretch, the board unlinked

workflows.name: resolution-keep
workflows.manual: 7. Resolution: Custom 800×480, Leave them where they are: each page remembers its resolution

workflows.name: resolution-keep-then-rotate
workflows.manual: 7. Resolution: Custom 800×480, Leave them where they are; then Rotate, Adapt
